design_note: The shared function names are preserved for Vox Mana cross-faction compatibility. Their Simic behavior translates control/constraint concepts into biomantic adaptation language.

functions.name: Detain
functions.simic_interpretation: Hold an unstable variable in a specimen state long enough to observe and redirect it.

input_contract.reason: why the signal needs temporary containment

output_contract.simic_read: plain-language explanation of the contained variable

functions.pseudo: Detain(target, reason) => StabilizedSpecimen({ target, reason, observation_window, release_condition })
functions.example: Detain(opponent_threat, "too large for current ecosystem") -> freeze as research object until adaptation catches up.

functions.name: Override
functions.simic_interpretation: Rewrite the operating pattern of a card, trait, or narrative signal into a more adaptive biological form.

input_contract.desired_trait: growth, evasion, protection, draw, ramp, or control

output_contract.mutation_cost: what must be spent or risked

functions.pseudo: Override(signal, desired_trait) => MutatedPattern({ original: signal, trait: desired_trait, cost, side_effect })
functions.example: Override(removal, "biomancy") -> transform the creature instead of simply destroying it.

functions.name: ConstraintField
functions.simic_interpretation: Define the environment that pressures adaptation: mana limits, board size, available counters, and threat ecology.
functions.pseudo: ConstraintField(environment, constraints) => EvolutionaryPressureMap({ rewarded_traits, blocked_paths, risk })
functions.example: ConstraintField(board, ["few counters", "large opposing flyers"]) -> prioritize reach, evasion, or counter acceleration.

functions.name: AccretionEngine
functions.simic_interpretation: Compound small advantages into visible evolution: counters, cards, mana, bodies, and abilities accumulating over time.

output_contract.threshold_payoff: what happens when enough growth accumulates

functions.pseudo: AccretionEngine(seed, growth_vectors) => GrowthLoop({ seed, vector_stack, trigger, threshold_payoff })
functions.example: AccretionEngine(Cloudfin Raptor, ["larger creatures", "+1/+1 counters", "evasion payoff"]) -> early threat becomes scaling aerial clock.

shared_terms.specimen: a card, mechanic, or user signal being observed
shared_terms.host: the card or UX element receiving counters/adaptation
shared_terms.cytoplast: portable growth marker; usually represented as +1/+1 counters or animated motes
shared_terms.zonot: deep context layer; a place where hidden structure emerges into the UI
shared_terms.krasis: hybrid synthesis of two or more traits into one new expression
